links.comparator_used: Vendor-provided pretrained model (VPM) used as-is, without localized fine-tuning
links.outcome: Auto-segmentation accuracy for CTV and OARs (DSC, 95HD, sensitivity, specificity, target volume) against ground truth contours
links.effect: LFT significantly improved CTV delineation accuracy (p < 0.05), outperforming VPM in target volume, DSC, 95HD and specificity; significant enhancement in small intestine segmentation; both models adequate for bladder and femoral heads. No performance degradation seen for either model on the GenEva dataset from a different CT simulator. Numeric values not given in the abstract.
links.quote: LFT significantly improved CTV delineation accuracy (p < 0.05) with LFT outperforming VPM in target volume, DSC, 95HD and specificity.
